BURSEVI:v8p196#3/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p196#3/r1.speaker: ابن الفارض
BURSEVI:v8p196#3/r1.claim: Ibn al-Farid’s cited verse says one who wastes life has no share of its wine-like blessing.
BURSEVI:v8p196#3/r1.anchor: على نفسه قليبك من ضاع عمره.

BURSEVI:v8p196#3/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p196#3/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p196#3/r2.claim: Some attain a share of this love but not fully; others never reach spiritual satiation, which is the state of perfection.
BURSEVI:v8p196#3/r2.anchor: ومن الناس من له نصيب من هذا الأمر لكن لا على وجه الكمال

BURSEVI:v8p196#3/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p196#3/r3.speaker: يحيى بن معاذ الرازي
BURSEVI:v8p196#3/r3.claim: Yahya ibn Muadh wrote that love’s cup had intoxicated him; Abu Yazid replied that the strong keep drinking without exhausting the drink or becoming satiated, even after seven seas.
BURSEVI:v8p196#3/r3.anchor: حكي أن يحيى بن معاذ الرازي رضي الله عنه : كتب إلى أبي يزيد البسطامي

BURSEVI:v8p201/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p201/r1.speaker: ابن عطاء
BURSEVI:v8p201/r1.claim: Ibn Ata distinguishes those who enter and leave divine service with proper conduct from those who behave badly in service; poor manners in nearness are graver than at a distance.
BURSEVI:v8p201/r1.anchor: قال ابن عطاء : لا يستوي من أحسن الدخول في خدمتنا

BURSEVI:v8p201/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p201/r2.speaker: ابن عطاء
BURSEVI:v8p201/r2.claim: God may pardon ignorant people for major sins yet hold the elect accountable for even a glance or turning aside.
BURSEVI:v8p201/r2.anchor: فقد يصفح عن الجهال في الكبائر ويؤاخذ الصديقون باللحظة والالتفات

BURSEVI:v8p201/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p201/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p201/r3.claim: The word talqiya can mean bringing something before someone; here it means being given the virtue of answering wrong with good, a quality that restrains revenge.

BURSEVI:v8p201/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p201/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p201/r4.claim: Only those characterized by patience receive this virtue, because patience holds the self back from retaliation.

BURSEVI:v8p201/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p201/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p201/r5.claim: The person of great allotted share has noble psychic qualities and spiritual strength; revenge reflects a weak self affected by external events, while inner strength makes bearing them easy.
BURSEVI:v8p201/r5.anchor: من الفضائل النفسانية والقوة الروحانية ، فإن الاشتغال بالانتقام

BURSEVI:v8p201/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p201/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p201/r6.claim: Purifying the self makes sweetness and bitterness equal, so an unwelcome event feels as though absent; the verse praises patience and an allotted share.
BURSEVI:v8p201/r6.anchor: والحاصل : أنه يلزم تزكية النفس حتى يستوي الحلو والمر

BURSEVI:v8p201/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p201/r7.speaker: الجنيد
BURSEVI:v8p201/r7.claim: Junayd says only a person favored by God’s special care is granted this station.
BURSEVI:v8p201/r7.anchor: قال الجنيد قدس سره في قوله : وما يلقاها إلا ذو حظ عظيم

BURSEVI:v8p201/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p201/r8.speaker: ابن عطاء
BURSEVI:v8p201/r8.claim: Ibn Ata interprets the person of great share as one who knows God and His days.
BURSEVI:v8p201/r8.anchor: وقال ابن عطاء : ذو معرفة بالله وأيامه

QASHANI:41:34-35/r4.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:41:34-35/r4.speaker: author
QASHANI:41:34-35/r4.claim: This noble trait is granted to those patient with God, unchanged by enemies' slips, trusting Him, taking on His forbearance or obeying His command; it is a great gift.
QASHANI:41:34-35/r4.anchor: مع الله، فلم يتغيروا بزلة الأعداء لرؤيتهم منه تعالى

SULAMI:v2p219#2/r1.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p219#2/r1.speaker: بعضهم
SULAMI:v2p219#2/r1.claim: Only those who endure the calamities and hardships of spiritual knowledge without valuing themselves can enter its company and penetrate it.
SULAMI:v2p219#2/r1.anchor: قال بعضهم : لا يطيق أحد الهجوم على المعارف إلا من يصبر على احتمال النوائب والشدائد فيها

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p293/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p293/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p293/r6.claim: The next clause is either coordinated with the command or circumstantial to “that which is best”; its pronoun denotes the best conduct in repelling, since good deeds generally can occur without patience.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p293/r6.anchor: وضمير { يلقاهآ } عائد إلى ( التي هي أحسن )

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p294/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p294/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p294/r1.claim: The verse urges training in this virtue: it takes resolve and patience to restrain the desire for revenge; patience itself is praised and greatly rewarded.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p294/r1.anchor: وهذا تحريض على الارتياض بهذه الخصلة بإظهار احتياجها إلى قوة عزم وشدة مراس للصبر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p294/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p294/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p294/r2.claim: Patient people endure hardship and control anger, making it easier for them to forgo retaliation; the verse links to the exception in 103:2–3.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p294/r2.anchor: فالصابر مرتاض بتحمل المكاره وتجرع الشدائد وكظم الغيظ فيهون عليه ترك الانتقام

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p294/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p294/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p294/r3.claim: Yulaqqāhā means making oneself attain it, metaphorically likening cultivation of the virtue to seeking and meeting someone; compare 76:11.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p294/r3.anchor: وهو مستعار للسعي لتحصيلها لأن التحصيل على الشيء بعد المعالجة والتخلق يشبه السعي

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p294/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p294/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p294/r4.claim: The two present-tense verbs portray future cultivation, while past “those who were patient” marks patience as an established prior trait; this explains avoiding “the patient.”
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p294/r4.anchor: للدلالة على أن الصبر خلق سابق فيهم هو العون على معاملة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p294/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p294/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p294/r5.claim: Ḥaẓẓ is a share, sometimes specifically of good; here it is a great share of virtue, right guidance, and piety. Patience is necessary but is only part of the broader qualification.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p294/r5.anchor: والحظ : النصيب من الشيء مطلقا ، وقيل : خاص بالنصيب

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p295/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p295/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p295/r1.claim: Repeating “none receives it” rather than coordinating the second clause heightens emphasis, leaving no part of the statement subordinate to a conjunction.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p295/r1.anchor: وفي إعادة فعل { وما يلقاها } دون اكتفاء بحرف العطف إظهار لمزيد

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p295/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p295/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p295/r2.claim: The construction “possessor of a great share” presents goodness as a settled disposition; the counsel is not an easy command for everyone.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p295/r2.anchor: وأفاد { ذو حظ عظيم } أن الحظ العظيم من الخير سجيته وملكته

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p16/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p16/r10.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p16/r10.claim: The praise of patience is comprehensive: patience in obedience and restraint from desires gathers the qualities of goodness.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p16/r10.anchor: وذلك بين للمتأمل، لأن الصبر للطاعات وعن الشهوات جامع

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p16/r11.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p16/r11.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p16/r11.claim: A report says Abu Bakr endured an insult silently until anger overcame him and he replied; the Prophet said an angel had defended him until he answered, when the angel left and Satan came.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p16/r11.anchor: وروي أن رجلا شتم أبا بكر الصديق بحضرة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فسكت أبو بكر ساعة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p16/r12.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p16/r12.speaker: قتادة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p16/r12.claim: Ḥaẓẓ ʿaẓīm may mean great intelligence and merit, or a large share of Paradise and afterlife reward; Qatada chooses Paradise.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p16/r12.anchor: والحظ العظيم: يحتمل أن يريد من العقل والفضل، فتكون الآية مدحا.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p258/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p258/r1.speaker: الزجاج
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p258/r1.claim: Al-Zajjāj says “it” is the practice of repelling an evil deed with a good one, and that only the patient are granted it.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p258/r1.anchor: قال الزجاج ما يلقى هذه الفعلة وهي دفع السيئة بالحسنة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p258/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p258/r2.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p258/r2.claim: The patient who attain this quality are those who restrain their anger.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p258/r2.anchor: ﴿ إلا الذين صبروا ﴾ على كظم الغيظ

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p258/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p258/r3.speaker: السدي
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p258/r3.claim: Al-Suddī glosses the great share as good fortune.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p258/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p258/r4.speaker: قتادة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p258/r4.claim: Qatāda identifies the great share as Paradise, so only those for whom Paradise is assured attain this quality.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p258/r4.anchor: وقال قتادة الحظ العظيم الجنة فالمعنى ما يلقاها إلا من وجبت له الجنة

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p181/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p181/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p181/r3.claim: Only people patient enough to overcome the soul’s resistance accept and practice this difficult counsel; they have abundant happiness in this life and next.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p181/r3.anchor: وما يقبل (3) هذه الوصية ويعمل بها إلا من صبر على ذلك

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p181/r17.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p181/r17.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p181/r17.claim: Only those patient in forbearance can meet evil with good; alternatively, the phrase means that only the patient in obedience attain Paradise.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p181/r17.anchor: ما يلقى دفع السيئة بالحسنة إلا الذين صبروا على الحلم . الثاني : ما يلقى الجنة

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p181/r18.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p181/r18.speaker: السدي
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p181/r18.claim: He glosses great fortune as great prosperity.

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p181/r19.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p181/r19.speaker: ابن عباس
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p181/r19.claim: He identifies great fortune as an abundant share of goodness.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p181/r19.anchor: ذو نصيب [ وافر ] من الخير , قاله ابن عباس

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p181/r20.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p181/r20.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p181/r20.claim: Another interpretation makes Paradise itself the great fortune; Hasan says nothing can be a greater fortune than Paradise.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p181/r20.anchor: أن الحظ العظيم الجنة . قال الحسن : والله ما عظم حظ قط دون الجنة

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p181/r21.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p181/r21.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p181/r21.claim: A further possible meaning is a person of excellent character.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p181/r21.anchor: ويحتمل رابعا : أنه ذو الخلق الحسن

MUQATIL:41:31-35/r3.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:41:31-35/r3.speaker: author
MUQATIL:41:31-35/r3.claim: Because Abu Jahl harmed Muhammad, whom the Prophet disliked, God commanded forgiveness and forbearance; patience in restraining anger may turn an enemy into a close ally, and Muhammad must seek refuge from Satan.
MUQATIL:41:31-35/r3.anchor: وذلك أن أبا جهل كان يؤذي النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، وكان النبي مبغضا له، يكره رؤيته

NASAFI-FULL:v4p90#5/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p90#5/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p90#5/r1.claim: The pronoun refers to repaying injury with kindness; only patient people, blessed with a great good fortune, can attain this quality.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p90#5/r1.anchor: ﴿ وما يلقاها ﴾ اى وما يلقى هذه الخصلة التى هي مقابلة الاساءة بالاحسان ﴿ إلا الذين صبروا ﴾ الا اهل الصبر

NASAFI-FULL:v4p90#5/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p90#5/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p90#5/r2.claim: The wording may answer an imagined question about how to act; alternatively, lā is emphatic, and the stronger comparative replaces the expected simple adjective to heighten the response.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p90#5/r2.anchor: وانما لم يقل فادفع بالتي هي احسن لانه تقدير قائل قال فكيف اصنع فقيل ادفع بالتي هى احسن وقيل لا مزيدة للتأكيد

NASAFI-FULL:v4p90#5/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p90#5/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
NASAFI-FULL:v4p90#5/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās explains the best response as patience in anger, forbearance amid ignorance, and pardon for injury; he interprets great fortune as reward.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p90#5/r3.anchor: وعن ابن عباس رضى الله عنهما بالتي هى احسن الصبرعند الغضب والحلم عند الجهل والعفو عند الاساءة وفسر الحظ بالثواب

NASAFI-FULL:v4p90#5/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p90#5/r4.speaker: الحسن
NASAFI-FULL:v4p90#5/r4.claim: Al-Ḥasan says no fortune is greater than Paradise.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p90#5/r4.anchor: وعن الحسن والله ما عظم حظ دون الجنة

NASAFI-FULL:v4p90#5/r5.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p90#5/r5.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p90#5/r5.claim: One report says the verse was revealed about Abū Sufyān ibn Ḥarb, an enemy who harmed the Prophet and later became a close friend.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p90#5/r5.anchor: وقيل نزلت في ابى سفيان بن حرب وكان عدوا مؤذيا للنبى صلى الله عليه وسلم فصار وليا مصافيا

QURTUBI-FULL:41:35-36/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:41:35-36/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:41:35-36/r1.claim: The pronoun refers to the noble practice of repelling harm; it is attained by those who restrain anger and endure injury.
QURTUBI-FULL:41:35-36/r1.anchor: يعني هذه الفعلة الكريمة والخصلة الشريفة { إلا الذين صبروا } بكظم الغيظ واحتمال الأذى

QURTUBI-FULL:41:35-36/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:41:35-36/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:41:35-36/r2.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas explains the great share as an abundant portion of good.
QURTUBI-FULL:41:35-36/r2.anchor: أي نصيب وافر من الخير قاله ابن عباس.

QURTUBI-FULL:41:35-36/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:41:35-36/r3.speaker: قتادة ومجاهد
QURTUBI-FULL:41:35-36/r3.claim: Qatadah and Mujahid interpret the great share as Paradise.
QURTUBI-FULL:41:35-36/r3.anchor: وقال قتادة ومجاهد: الحظ العظيم الجنة.

QURTUBI-FULL:41:35-36/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:41:35-36/r4.speaker: الحسن
QURTUBI-FULL:41:35-36/r4.claim: Al-Hasan says nothing is a great share apart from Paradise.
QURTUBI-FULL:41:35-36/r4.anchor: قال الحسن: والله ما عظم حظ قط دون الجنة.

QURTUBI-FULL:41:35-36/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:41:35-36/r5.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:41:35-36/r5.claim: An alternative takes the pronoun as Paradise itself; the meaning remains close because the patient attain it.
QURTUBI-FULL:41:35-36/r5.anchor: وقيل: الكناية في «يلقاها» عن الجنة أي ما يلقاها إلا الصابرون والمعنى متقارب.

SAMIN-DURR:41:35/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:41:35/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:41:35/r1.claim: The common reading uses the passive of تلقية; Ibn Kathir in one transmission and Talha ibn Musarrif read يلاقاها from ملاقاة.
SAMIN-DURR:41:35/r1.anchor: العامة على " يلقاها " من التلقية. وابن كثير في رواية وطلحة بن مصرف " يلاقاها

SAMIN-DURR:41:35/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:41:35/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:41:35/r2.claim: The pronoun may refer to the quality, word, Garden, or testimony of divine unity.
SAMIN-DURR:41:35/r2.anchor: والضمير للخصلة، أو الكلمة أو الجنة أو لشهادة التوحيد

RAZI-FULL:v27p110/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v27p110/r3.speaker: الزجاج
RAZI-FULL:v27p110/r3.claim: Al-Zajjāj says only those who endure hardship, swallow distress, restrain anger, and leave revenge can attain this conduct.
RAZI-FULL:v27p110/r3.anchor: قال الزجاج : أي وما يلقى هذه الفعلة إلا الذين صبروا على تحمل المكاره

RAZI-FULL:v27p110/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v27p110/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v27p110/r4.claim: Attaining this way requires a strong, pure soul: a strong inner substance is not shaken or hurt by external events and therefore does not seek revenge.
RAZI-FULL:v27p110/r4.anchor: لا يلقاها إلا ذو حظ عظيم من قوة النفس وصفاء الجوهر وطهارة الذات

RAZI-FULL:v27p110/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v27p110/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v27p110/r5.claim: Alternatively, “a great share” may mean a great share of the afterlife reward; the first clause praises patience and the second promises recompense.

STUDYQURAN:41:35/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:41:35/r1.speaker: Ṭs
STUDYQURAN:41:35/r1.claim: Only those who restrain anger and patiently bear harm can repel evil with good.
STUDYQURAN:41:35/r1.anchor: those who conceal their anger and bear what harm is done to them with patience (Ṭs)

STUDYQURAN:41:35/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:41:35/r2.speaker: IJ
STUDYQURAN:41:35/r2.claim: A great share may refer to a person’s good fortune.
STUDYQURAN:41:35/r2.anchor: A great share refers to one of good fortune (IJ)

STUDYQURAN:41:35/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:41:35/r3.speaker: Ṭs
STUDYQURAN:41:35/r3.claim: A great share may mean abundant intellect and vision.
STUDYQURAN:41:35/r3.anchor: an abundance of intellect and vision (Ṭs)

STUDYQURAN:41:35/r4.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:41:35/r4.speaker: R
STUDYQURAN:41:35/r4.claim: A great share may mean elevated virtue, spiritual strength, and inner purity.
STUDYQURAN:41:35/r4.anchor: a high degree of virtue, spiritual strength, and inner purity (R)

STUDYQURAN:41:35/r5.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:41:35/r5.speaker: IJ, Ṭ, Ṭs
STUDYQURAN:41:35/r5.claim: A great share may refer to Paradise.
STUDYQURAN:41:35/r5.anchor: Great fortune may also be understood as a reference to Paradise (IJ, Ṭ, Ṭs)

TAB-FULL:v20p434#2/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v20p434#2/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v20p434#2/r1.claim: Only someone with a great share and a prior record of good deeds can attain this quality; some say the great share is Paradise.
TAB-FULL:v20p434#2/r1.anchor: عن قتادة، {وما يلقاها إلا الذين صبروا} [فصلت: 35] . . . الآية " والحظ العظيم: الجنة

TAB-FULL:v20p434#2/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v20p434#2/r2.speaker: السدي
TAB-FULL:v20p434#2/r2.claim: Al-Suddi glosses the great share as good fortune.
TAB-FULL:v20p434#2/r2.anchor: عن السدي، في قوله: {وما يلقاها إلا ذو حظ عظيم} [فصلت: 35] ذو جد

TAB-FULL:v20p434#2/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v20p434#2/r3.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v20p434#2/r3.claim: Qatada identifies the great share as Paradise and tells how the Prophet left when Abu Bakr answered an insult: an angel had defended Abu Bakr, but Satan came when he retaliated, and the Prophet would not sit with Satan.
TAB-FULL:v20p434#2/r3.anchor: عن قتادة، {وما يلقاها إلا الذين صبروا} [فصلت: 35] . . . الآية " والحظ العظيم: الجنة " ذكر لنا أن أبا بكر رضي الله عنه شتمه رجل

TAB-FULL:v20p434#2/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v20p434#2/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB-FULL:v20p434#2/r4.claim: Ibn Abbas says those able to attain this are the people God has prepared for Paradise.
TAB-FULL:v20p434#2/r4.anchor: عن ابن عباس، قوله: {وما يلقاها إلا الذين صبروا وما يلقاها إلا ذو حظ عظيم} [فصلت: 35] يقول: «الذين أعد الله لهم الجنة»

ZAJJAJ:v4p385/r12.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p385/r12.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p385/r12.claim: The feminine pronoun refers to receiving the recompense for this virtuous act, or to receiving the act itself.
ZAJJAJ:v4p385/r12.anchor: أي ما يلقى مجازاة هذا أي وما يلقى هذه الفعلة

ZAJJAJ:v4p385/r13.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p385/r13.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p385/r13.claim: Those who receive it are the patient ones who restrain their anger.
ZAJJAJ:v4p385/r13.anchor:
الذين صبروا) أي
إلا الذين يكظمون الغيظ.

ZAJJAJ:v4p385/r14.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p385/r14.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p385/r14.claim: The great portion is Paradise, which only those for whom Paradise is due will receive.
ZAJJAJ:v4p385/r14.anchor: الحظ ههنا الجنة، أي وما يلقاها إلا من وجبت له الجنة

ZAJJAJ:v4p385/r15.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p385/r15.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p385/r15.claim: A great portion means a great share in goodness.

TABATABAI:41:33-35/r10.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:41:33-35/r10.speaker: author
TABATABAI:41:33-35/r10.claim: Only the patient attain this response, and the person who receives it has a great share of human perfection and good qualities; this shows such a share belongs especially to the patient.
TABATABAI:41:33-35/r10.anchor: أي ذو نصيب وافر من كمال الإنسانية وخصال الخير. وفي الآية مع ذلك دلالة ظاهرة على أن الحظ العظيم إنما

TABRISI:41:34-35/r10.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:41:34-35/r10.speaker: author
TABRISI:41:34-35/r10.claim: “It” is the practice of answering evil with good, which only the patient achieve by restraining anger and bearing what pains them.
TABRISI:41:34-35/r10.anchor: هذه الفعلة وهذه الحالة التي هي دفع السيئة بالحسنة

TABRISI:41:34-35/r11.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:41:34-35/r11.speaker: أبو عبد الله
TABRISI:41:34-35/r11.claim: Another report says those who endure worldly harm attain this quality.
TABRISI:41:34-35/r11.anchor: إلا الذين صبروا في الدنيا في الأذى عن أبي عبد الله ع

TABRISI:41:34-35/r12.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:41:34-35/r12.speaker: author
TABRISI:41:34-35/r12.claim: A great share may mean abundant insight and reason, or a plentiful share of reward and good.
TABRISI:41:34-35/r12.anchor: نصيب وافر من الرأي والعقل. وقيل: إلا ذو نصيب عظيم من الثواب

TABRISI:41:34-35/r13.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:41:34-35/r13.speaker: قتادة
TABRISI:41:34-35/r13.claim: Qatāda says the great share is Paradise, attained by those for whom it has been ordained.
TABRISI:41:34-35/r13.anchor: الحظ العظيم الجنة عن قتادة وما يلقاها إلا من وجبت له الجنة

TABRISI:41:34-35/r14.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:41:34-35/r14.speaker: أبو عبد الله
TABRISI:41:34-35/r14.claim: Abu ʿAbd Allāh transmits the wording “only everyone with a great share.”
TABRISI:41:34-35/r14.anchor: وروي عن أبي عبد الله ع وما يلقاها إلا كل ذي حظ عظيم

THALABI:v8p297/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v8p297/r1.speaker: author
THALABI:v8p297/r1.claim: The trait of repelling evil with what is better is granted only to the patient and to one with a great share of good and reward.
THALABI:v8p297/r1.anchor: وما يلقاها يعني هذه الخصلة والفعلة. إلا الذين صبروا وما يلقاها إلا ذو حظ عظيم

THALABI:v8p297/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v8p297/r2.speaker: قيل
THALABI:v8p297/r2.claim: Another gloss says it means a person with a share.
THALABI:v8p297/r2.anchor: وما يلقاها إلا ذو حظ عظيم في الخير والثواب، وقيل: ذو حظ.

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:41:34-38/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:41:34-38/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:41:34-38/r2.claim: Only those patient in restraining anger and enduring harm attain this trait; the great share is Paradise.

ELMALILI:41:33-39#2/r5.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:41:33-39#2/r5.speaker: author
ELMALILI:41:33-39#2/r5.claim: Only those who cultivate patience can attain the disposition of repelling evil with the best response, since true patience restrains revenge.
ELMALILI:41:33-39#2/r5.anchor: kötülüğü en güzel hasene ile def‘etmek seciyesine ancak sabredenler, sabrı huy edinenler erdirilir

ELMALILI:41:33-39#2/r6.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:41:33-39#2/r6.speaker: author
ELMALILI:41:33-39#2/r6.claim: This disposition is reached only by someone with a great spiritual share, a high soul and virtue, and a large gift from God.
ELMALILI:41:33-39#2/r6.anchor: kuvve-i rûhiyye ve fezâil-i nefsiyeden yüksek bir derece ile, ni‘met-i ilâhiyeden büyük bir nasîbe mazhar olmuş

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:41:34/r7.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:41:34/r7.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:41:34/r7.claim: Verse 35 makes the instruction a universal moral principle and says returning evil with good is difficult yet a high ethical aim whose first condition is patience.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:41:34/r7.anchor: kötülüğe iyilikle karşılık vermenin, nefse ağır geldiğine, ama aynı zamanda yüksek bir ahlâkî hedef olduğuna

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:41:34/r8.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:41:34/r8.speaker: İbn Âşûr
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:41:34/r8.claim: The people of great share are patient and adorned with supporting moral virtues.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:41:34/r8.anchor: sabrın yanında onu destekleyici mahiyetteki ahlâkî erdemlerle bezenmiş olanları ifade etmektedir

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:41:34/r9.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:41:34/r9.speaker: İbn Atıyye
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:41:34/r9.claim: The great share can mean intelligence and virtue, or possibly paradise and afterlife reward, in which case the verse promises that reward.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:41:34/r9.anchor: “büyük pay” deyimiyle akıl ve erdemin kastedildiğini belirtir

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p62/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p62/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p62/r4.claim: The Prophet carries a noble call and should answer ignorant opposition with decency and forgiveness, a difficult but wise approach attained through patience.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p62/r4.anchor: he should counter their ignorance with decency and forgiveness

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p81/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p81/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p81/r3.claim: The Prophet should patiently forgive naïve opponents who disrupt the blessed message; this gracious response benefits his preaching.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p81/r3.anchor: he should patiently forgive this misdemeanour. This gracious behaviour from him will bring great benefit and blessings to his preaching endeavour.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p88/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p88/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p88/r2.claim: The pronoun “it” has no stated antecedent and refers to the wisdom commanded in the previous verse; this unexpressed-reference construction is common in Arabic.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p88/r2.anchor: it refers to the wisdom which the previous verse instructs Muslims to adopt

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p88/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p88/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p88/r3.claim: The wisdom of answering evil with better conduct is attainable only by the patient; it is a profound, lasting treasure, so people should cultivate patience and strive to acquire it.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p88/r3.anchor: this wisdom can be attained only by those who have the trait of patience

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p188/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p188/r1.speaker: قتادة
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p188/r1.claim: Qatada identifies the great share with Paradise.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p188/r1.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله ﴿ ذو حظ عظيم ﴾ قال الحظ العظيم الجنة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r10.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r10.claim: The feminine pronoun refers to the trait or disposition of repelling evil with a better response.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r10.anchor: وما يلقاها: الضمير عائد على الفعلة والسجية التي هي الدفع بالأحسن

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r11.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r11.speaker: طلحة بن مصرف وابن كثير
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r11.claim: They have an alternate reading with yāʾ, from the verb meaning to meet or encounter.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r11.anchor: وقرأ طلحة بن مصرف، وابن كثير في رواية: وما يلاقاها: من الملاقاة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r12.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r12.speaker: الجمهور
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r12.claim: They read the verb as receiving or being granted the trait.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r13.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r13.speaker: ابن عباس
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r13.claim: He says only those steadfast in obedience and turning away from desires attain this rare virtue; it is praise for them.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r13.anchor: إلا لمن كان صابرا على الطاعات، صارفا عن الشهوات

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r14.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r14.speaker: قتادة
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r14.claim: He reads the great fortune as the reward of the afterlife, making the verse a promise.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r14.anchor: ذو حظ عظيم من ثواب الآخرة، قاله قتادة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r15.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r15.speaker: قيل
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r15.claim: Other reported readings of the great fortune are intelligence or good character.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r15.anchor: وقيل: إلا ذو عقل. وقيل: ذو خلق حسن

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r16.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r16.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r16.claim: The repeated “only those steadfast receive it” emphasizes the excellence of this noble trait.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p306/r16.anchor: وكرر وما يلقاها تأكيدا لهذه الفعلة الجميلة الجليلة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p307/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p307/r1.speaker: مكي
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p307/r1.claim: He says the pronoun means the testimony that there is no god but God; the author considers this far-fetched.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p307/r1.anchor: وحكى مكي: وما يلقاها: أي شهادة أن لا إله إلا الله، وفيه بعد

ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r1.claim: The pronoun refers to the noble act of answering evil with the best response, understood from context; it may alternatively refer to the best response itself.
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r1.anchor: أي ما يلقى ويؤتى هذه الفعلة والخصلة الشريفة التي هي الدفع بالتي هي أحسن

ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r2.claim: A transmitted but unpersuasive interpretation makes the pronoun refer to the testimony that there is no god but God, by construing it as the best response; another says it means Paradise, which Alusi dismisses.
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r2.anchor: وحكى محكي أن الضمير لشهادة أن لا إله إلا الله فكأنه أرجع للتي هي أحسن

ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r3.claim: Talha and Ibn Kathir in one transmission read the verb as “meets” rather than “is granted.”
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r3.anchor: وقرأ طلحة وابن كثير في رواية ( وما يلاقاها )

ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r4.claim: Ibn Abbas says a person of great fortune has excellent traits and a perfected soul; on this reading the clause praises the person.
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r4.anchor: ذو نصيب عظيم من خصال الخير وكمال النفس كما روي عن ابن عباس

ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r5.speaker: قتادة
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r5.claim: Qatada says the great fortune is a great reward, making the clause a promise; another view says it is Paradise.
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r5.anchor: وقال قتادة : ذو حظ عظيم من الثواب

ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r6.claim: Repeating “is granted” reinforces praise of this eminent moral act.
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r6.anchor: تلك الفعلة الجليلة ولأوحد أهل عصره

ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r7.speaker: صالح أفندي
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r7.claim: Salih Efendi offers a logical wordplay: the two universal premises yield that every patient person has great fortune, a positive universal conclusion; this lets the patient recognize his good lot and remain within patience.
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r7.anchor: قوله تعالى : ( وما يلقاها إلا الذين صبروا ) الآية يمكن أن يؤخذ

ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r8.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r8.claim: Alusi reconstructs the wordplay as a first-figure syllogism: every patient person receives the act, and everyone receiving it has great fortune; the positive universal conclusion is the noblest categorical form.
ALUSI-FULL:v24p123#3/r8.anchor: كل صابر هو الذي يلقاها وكل من يلقاها فهو ذو حظ عظيم ينتج كل صابر هو ذو حظ عظيم

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p175/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p175/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p175/r1.claim: The feminine pronoun refers to the virtue of meeting evil with good; only those patient in restraining anger and bearing harm attain it.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p175/r1.anchor: {وما يلقاها} ما يلقى هذه الخصلة وهي دفع السيئة بالحسنة، {إلا الذين صبروا} على كظم الغيظ واحتمال المكروه،

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p175/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p175/r2.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p175/r2.claim: The person of great fortune has great goodness and reward.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p175/r2.anchor: {وما يلقاها إلا ذو حظ عظيم} في الخير والثواب،

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p175/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p175/r3.speaker: قتادة
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p175/r3.claim: Qatada identifies the great fortune as Paradise: only one destined for Paradise attains this virtue.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p175/r3.anchor: وقال قتادة: "الحظ العظيم": الجنة، أي: ما يلقاها إلا من وجبت له الجنة.

BAYDAWI-FULL:41:34-35/r4.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:41:34-35/r4.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:41:34-35/r4.claim: The disposition means answering injury with goodness; patience restrains revenge, so only the patient attain it.
BAYDAWI-FULL:41:34-35/r4.anchor: وما يلقى هذه السجية وهي مقابلته الإساءة بالإحسان

BAYDAWI-FULL:41:34-35/r5.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:41:34-35/r5.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:41:34-35/r5.claim: The great share means abundant good and perfection of the soul; another view identifies it as Paradise.
BAYDAWI-FULL:41:34-35/r5.anchor: من الخير وكمال النفس وقيل الحظ الجنة

BIQAI-FULL:v6p573/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p573/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p573/r1.claim: Answering injury with the best response, beyond forgiveness, forbearance, and patience, serves all the interests of religion and worldly life, but it is contrary to human disposition and must be sought from God.
BIQAI-FULL:v6p573/r1.anchor: التي هي مقابلة الإساءة بأحسن الحسن وهو الإحسان

BIQAI-FULL:v6p573/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p573/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p573/r2.claim: The repeated passive ‘it is granted’ emphasizes that God enables the patient to acquire this virtue; the shift from plural ‘those who are patient’ to singular ‘one of great fortune’ stresses its rarity and rank.
BIQAI-FULL:v6p573/r2.anchor: وكرر إظهار البناء للمفعول للتنبيه على أنه لا قدرة عليها أصلا إلا بتوفيق الخالق

BIQAI-FULL:v6p573/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p573/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p573/r3.claim: The person granted this virtue has an immense share and standing with God and people in this life and the next.
BIQAI-FULL:v6p573/r3.anchor: أي جليل في الدنيا والآخرة عند الله وعند الناس

JISHUMI:v9p6192/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6192/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v9p6192/r1.claim: Talaqqī means receiving a report from someone else; al-Muʾarrij also glosses it as accepting.
JISHUMI:v9p6192/r1.anchor: والتلقي: أخذ الحديث من غيره، تلقيت الحديث منه: أخذته، قال المؤرج: تلقى: قبل.

JISHUMI:v9p6192/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6192/r3.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v9p6192/r3.claim: The pronoun in “none receives it” can refer to the stated virtue or previously described way of life.
JISHUMI:v9p6192/r3.anchor: والهاء في قوله: (وما يلقاها) كناية عن الخصلة، أي: ما يلقى الخصلة المذكورة، أو السيرة المتقدمة

JISHUMI:v9p6192/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6192/r4.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v9p6192/r4.claim: Another interpretation takes the pronoun in “none receives it” to refer to righteous deeds.

DAMGHANI:v1p418/r4.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p418/r4.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p418/r4.claim: Liqāʾ can mean being given something; patience is given only to the steadfast, and the source cites 76:11.
DAMGHANI:v1p418/r4.anchor: اللقاء العطاء قوله سبحانه في سورة حم السجدة

NAHHAS:v4p62/r6.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p62/r6.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p62/r6.claim: The expression is described as an indirect reference to the state and to the expression just mentioned.
NAHHAS:v4p62/r6.anchor: الكناية عن الحال وعن هذه الكلمة
